issue_request: FHIR-17045 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked how to type a Bundle returned by an operation when the resources were generated by the operation. The approved resolution said the type is collection unless the Bundle has search semantics such as pages, next links, or totals, and asked to clarify the documentation.

additional_context: source/operations.html is build-scoped via publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. Later Published issue FHIR-32015 intentionally broadened the same paragraph because operations such as Composition $document can return document Bundles; the combined branch already contains the FHIR-32015 reconciliation commit, so FHIR-17045 should be interpreted through that later approved refinement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already says response Bundles are typically collection, can be other Bundle types, and should be searchset when an operation has search semantics with matching counts and page links.
